proposal.title: [Client] brand identity, proposal
proposal.project: A brand identity for [Client]: name check, mark, type, colour and the first applications, delivered as one system the team can use.
proposal.problem: [One or two sentences in the client's own words: what is costing them customers today, and how we will know it is fixed.]

deliverables: A short review of your market, customers and three competitors, and the one idea the brand will stand on.
A wordmark or symbol, tested from a 16 px app icon to a shopfront.
Type, colour and layout rules, with a one-page guide.
[Three first applications, e.g. social templates, a business card and a website header.]
All master files in vector and image formats, with usage notes.
process: We study your customers, market and competitors first.
One clear thought the whole brand can stand on.
Real applications, not mock-ups of a logo on a blank page.
We test it with real use, then refine it once.
proposal.price_note: Prices exclude any taxes that apply. Two rounds of revisions are included; further rounds are quoted before they start.
next: Reply to accept this proposal, or ask anything that is unclear.
We send the contract and the first invoice for the deposit.
A 45-minute call to agree goals, the decision-maker and the schedule.

contract.title: [Client] brand identity, contract
contract.parties: This contract is made between May11Leven Labs ([legal name and registered address]), "the Studio", and [Client company] ([registered address]), represented by [Name], "the Client".
contract.project: The Studio will design a brand identity for the Client as set out in proposal M11-PRO-0001, which forms part of this contract.
clauses: Scope
The Studio delivers the work listed in the proposal. Anything outside it is quoted in writing before it starts.
Schedule
Work starts when the deposit is paid and the Client has supplied the agreed material. Delays in feedback move the schedule by the same amount.
Fees and payment
The fee is [amount and currency], paid 50% on signature and 50% on delivery. Invoices are due within 14 days.
Revisions
Two rounds of revisions are included at each stage. Further rounds are charged at [day rate] and agreed before they start.
Client duties
The Client names one decision-maker, gives feedback within [5] working days and confirms it has the rights to any material it supplies.
Ownership
When the final payment is received, the Client owns the final approved designs. The Studio keeps ownership of drafts, unused concepts and its own tools and methods.
Portfolio
The Studio may show the finished work in its portfolio and social media after launch, unless the Client asks in writing for it not to.
Confidentiality
Each party keeps the other's non-public information confidential, during and after the project.
Cancellation
Either party may end this contract with written notice. The Client pays for work done up to that point; the deposit is not refundable once work has started.
Liability
Each party's total liability under this contract is limited to the total fee, except where the law does not allow this limit.
Governing law
This contract is governed by the laws of [country], and disputes go to the courts of [city].
